I am an old man now, 81 years, and my strength is not what it was. This small bean plot I keep near the house because beans do not need so much fertilizer like maize — they find their own nitrogen in the soil. I will put a little manure from the goats, use the seeds I saved from last harvest like my father taught me, and my children and grandchildren will help me with the weeding when the rains come. I have no money for chemical fertilizer on beans when the maize plot needs it more, and the FISP coupon if I get one goes to the maize.
